novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a mechanistic decomposition: it proposes that alarming cues “fire the refusal-execution circuit directly, bypassing the model's internal harmfulness assessment,” yielding separate harmfulness-belief, trigger-salience, and refusal-execution pathways. Searches around “LLM over-refusal lexical trigger mechanism,” “harmfulness belief refusal direction,” and “activation steering refusal trigger keywords” identify the closest work as Beyond Over-Refusal (2025), which diagnoses refusal-inducing “Focus” keywords and applies attention steering, and ACTOR/Just Enough Shifts (2025), which adjusts activation components that trigger over-refusal; the cited Zhao et al. belief/refusal separation could not be independently verified here. The step is a substantive multi-step integration rather than a mere object change, but the bypass hypothesis is a natural extension of already-known trigger-word over-refusal plus separable refusal representations, so it contributes a new causal operationalization rather than an entirely new core paradigm.
